findings.claim: 10-K 列出主要對手為 Broadcom、Credo、Marvell、Microchip、Montage、Parade、Rambus；對手多只在部分產品線重疊。
findings.excerpt: Our competitors typically compete with us with respect to some, but not all, of our solutions. Our principal competitors include Broadcom, Inc., Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd., Marvell Technology, Inc., Microchip Technology Inc., Montage Technology, Parade Technologies, Ltd., and Rambus, Inc.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：對手可能較易取得設計導入（design wins），CXL 與 UALink 仍在早期採用，若大廠不支持同一標準或出現競爭標準，公司可能失去份額。
findings.excerpt: As a result, some of our competitors may be better situated to meet changing customer needs and secure design wins. Increasing competition in the markets in which we operate may negatively impact our revenue and gross margins.

findings.claim: Astera 公布 Scorpio X-Series 320 lane 交換器，2026 下半年量產，目標為商用 scale-up 市場。
findings.source: Astera Labs Q1 2026 財報新聞稿 (barchart)

findings.claim: Zacks 稱 Credo 在光學 DSP 持續拿下份額，Astera 同時面對 Broadcom 與 Credo 的競爭。
findings.source: Zacks: ALAB benefits from PCIe demand, can it stay ahead of its competitors

note: 搜尋未找到可信的 2026 份額數據或具名新進入者取代 ALAB 的報導；僅有部落格層級的 Broadcom 威脅看法，未採用。Q1 2026 新聞稿提到 Scorpio X-Series 規模內擴交換器預計 2026 下半年放量，見 clues。 線索 2 條，程式核實 0 條，2 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
